prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Astrax Mire. Character visual motifs: veiled pilgrim whose long measuring cords float behind a star-map walking staff; no portal-clone mobility burst.
TOP LEFT: Footfall Record. Ability concept: within sight, tracks enemy travel distance over rolling 3 s windows (max 160 GU) with public meter marks.
TOP RIGHT: Measure Out. Ability concept: tags one visible enemy for 3 s. Each 35 GU it voluntarily moves adds one Distance Seal (max 3); stationary targets remain safe.
BOTTOM LEFT: Mile Marker. Ability concept: sets a small stone marker on terrain. Tagged enemies moving **toward** it are slowed lightly; moving away consumes one Distance Seal harmlessly.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Reckoning of Roads. Ability concept: within 140 GU, all tagged enemies receive a visible 1 s verdict countdown. It converts accumulated seals into a capped nonlethal magical burst and movement-speed reduction; seals can be shed by walking away from markers before verdict. Does not teleport, leap, or create rift damage explosions.
